decision: Confluence integration indexes page titles, labels, and URLs only; full page content is not stored locally to avoid large storage payloads and PII exposure.
key_insight: Confluence integration indexes page titles, labels, and URLs only; full page content is not stored locally to avoid large storage payloads and PII exposure.
alternatives_considered: Store full Confluence page body for later full-text search
rejected_reason: Full page content may include sensitive HR, performance, or commercial data not appropriate for a local SQLite file
Full-text indexing of Confluence is deferred to Quorum Oracle semantic search in a later phase
